english.note: Use this as the everyday choice for replacing or swapping one thing for another.

exampleSentences.english: I want to exchange it for a bigger coat.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 wun6 gin6 daai6 di1 ge3 ngoi6 tou3

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when exchanging something for a new or equivalent one.

exampleSentences.english: I need to replace my phone with a new one.
exampleSentences.traditional: 部手機壞咗，我要換部新嘅。
exampleSentences.jyutping: bou6 sau2 gei1 waai6 zo2 ngo5 jiu3 wun6 bou6 san1 ge3

english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for giving or exchanging one thing for another.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 nei5 wun6 wai2 co5 laa1

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for swapping one thing for another or changing places.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 wun6 wai2 co5 laa1

english.note: Use this for replacing one thing with another, including changing clothes when the context makes that clear.

exampleSentences.english: I want to change my phone.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 wun6 bou6 din6 waa2
